front: Symptom: Janky scroll-linked animation — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Main thread long tasks · Fix: Move to transform; offload work; passive: true listeners

front: Symptom: Fan spin / GPU memory spike — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Layer count · Fix: Remove excess will-change; avoid promoting huge elements

front: Symptom: Animation stutters every N ms — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: GC or layout in loop · Fix: Profile Performance tab; eliminate FSL

front: Symptom: Works desktop, dies mobile — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Too many paints / layers · Fix: Reduce blur/shadow animation; simplify

front: Symptom: position: fixed jank during scroll — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Compositor + scroll mismatch · Fix: transform: translateZ(0) sparingly; check containing block

front: Symptom: CLS after animation — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Layout-affecting exit · Fix: Animate transform/opacity; reserve space

front: Gotcha with Animation: what silently fails?
back: will-change: transform on everything — mobile Safari/Chrome may exhaust GPU memory; toggle only during active animation.

front: When should you NOT use Animation?
back: Reduced motion users — respect prefers-reduced-motion: reduce; provide instant state change. Critical path LCP element — don't animate hero image/container until after LCP. Heavy box-shadow on large lists — paint cost scales with pixels; use border or static shadow image.

front: What is Flash of Unstyled Content (FOUC) in one sentence?
back: Brief display of unstyled or wrong-theme HTML before CSS loads — users see a layout jump; Lighthouse flags CLS; trust drops on first paint.

front: Explain the mental model of Flash of Unstyled Content (FOUC) (how the system thinks).
back: The browser parses HTML incrementally. If CSS arrives after first paint, content renders with user-agent defaults (or wrong theme), then reflows when rules apply.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for Flash of Unstyled Content (FOUC)?
back: Timeline (bad): → HTML parsed ──► first paint (ugly) ──► CSS arrives ──► restyle + reflow (FOUC) → Timeline (good): → CSS discovered early ──► block render until CSSOM ──► first paint (styled)

front: Given a broken Flash of Unstyled Content (FOUC) setup, what is your first validation command?
back: Timeline (bad):

front: Symptom: White page → styled jump — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: CSS <link> at bottom of body · Fix: Move stylesheets to <head>; inline critical CSS

front: Symptom: Dark mode flash (light then dark) — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Theme JS at end of body · Fix: Inline theme script in <head>; use color-scheme CSS

front: Symptom: FOUC only on slow 3G — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Waterfall: CSS after JS · Fix: Preload CSS; reduce JS blocking; split bundles

front: Symptom: FOUC after deploy only — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: CDN cache miss / hashed filename mismatch · Fix: Verify cache headers; atomic deploys

front: Symptom: React hydration warning + flash — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: SSR/client class mismatch · Fix: Fix SSR style collection; consistent builds

front: Symptom: Text jumps when font loads — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: font-display: swap without metrics · Fix: Use size-adjust, fallback stack, or optional

front: Symptom: FOUC with Tailwind CDN — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Full utility CSS loads async · Fix: Build CSS at compile time; don't rely on CDN in prod

front: Gotcha with Flash of Unstyled Content (FOUC): what silently fails?
back: @import inside CSS — forces serial fetch; each import blocks the next. Prefer <link> tags or bundler imports.

front: When should you NOT use Flash of Unstyled Content (FOUC)?
back: Hiding body with visibility:hidden until load — hurts LCP and accessibility; fix CSS delivery instead. Blocking all JS for style — overkill; inline tiny theme/critical CSS, async the rest. Aggressive font-display: block — eliminates FOUT but can hide text for seconds on slow networks.

front: What is CSS image sizing (clipped container) in one sentence?
back: When a parent clips width but uses width/height: 100%, browsers disagree on which box defines 100% — fix with explicit object-fit and containment.

front: Explain the mental model of CSS image sizing (clipped container) (how the system thinks).
back: A progress bar or clipped div sets used width via % or flex. Child img with w-full h-full (Tailwind) or width:100%; height:100% resolves percentages against different containing blocks in Chrome vs Firefox if overflow/containment differs. object-fit + fixed aspect on the img decouples layout from intrinsic image dimensions.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for CSS image sizing (clipped container)?
back: Parent (overflow:hidden, width: 40%) → Fix: img { width:100%; height:100%; object-fit: cover; display:block; }

front: Given a broken CSS image sizing (clipped container) setup, what is your first validation command?
back: Parent (overflow:hidden, width: 40%)

front: Symptom: Chrome stretched, Firefox correct — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: DevTools computed sizes · Fix: object-fit: cover; display:block removes inline gap

front: Symptom: Image overflows clip — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Parent overflow · Fix: overflow:hidden on clip container not img

front: Symptom: Aspect ratio collapse — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: No explicit height · Fix: Parent aspect-ratio or fixed height

front: Symptom: Blurry upscale — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Intrinsic vs display size · Fix: Serve correct resolution; srcset

front: Symptom: CLS on load — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: No width/height attrs · Fix: width/height HTML attrs or aspect-ratio

front: Gotcha with CSS image sizing (clipped container): what silently fails?
back: Inline img baseline gap — display:block or vertical-align:bottom fixes 4px leak. object-fit ignored — needs explicit width and height on replaced element. Percentage height chain — parent needs defined height all the way up.

front: When should you NOT use CSS image sizing (clipped container)?
back: Don't fight img in clip for decorative fills — background-image is simpler. Don't use object-fit: none unless you mean pixel-exact cropping.

front: What is scss in one sentence?
back: SCSS in 2026: still valuable for design tokens, mixins, and partials — but lean on native CSS where it caught up — Sass team + modern CSS spec.

front: Explain the mental model of scss (how the system thinks).
back: SCSS = CSS + variables, nesting, mixins, functions, @use modules. Build step compiles to plain CSS.

front: Symptom: Duplicate CSS in bundle — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Leftover @import · Fix: Migrate to @use; single entry @forward barrel

front: Symptom: Undefined variable — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Namespace · Fix: @use 'tokens/colors' as c; → c.$primary

front: Symptom: Deprecation warnings CI fail — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: dart-sass 1.80+ · Fix: Replace @import, / division → math.div()

front: Symptom: Huge CSS output — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: @extend chains · Fix: Prefer mixins or utility classes

front: Symptom: Dark mode tokens wrong — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Compile-time $vars only · Fix: Move theme to CSS custom properties

front: Symptom: Slow builds — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: @use graph + source maps · Fix: --quiet-deps; limit additionalData glob

front: Gotcha with scss: what silently fails?
back: @extend across files — unpredictable selector bloat and ordering bugs; prefer mixins or utility classes.

front: When should you NOT use scss?
back: New micro-frontends with Tailwind/CSS-in-JS — SCSS adds build complexity without team buy-in. Runtime theming / user accent colors — CSS custom properties only. One-off static landing — plain CSS or utility framework faster than token architecture.

front: What is Tailwind CSS in one sentence?
back: Utility-first CSS framework — compose designs from constrained class names; build step tree-shakes unused utilities for production.

front: Explain the mental model of Tailwind CSS (how the system thinks).
back: Tailwind is not a component library. It generates atomic utility classes (flex, pt-4, text-slate-600) from a config file. At build time, it scans your source files and emits only used rules — keeping prod CSS small.

front: Which standard commands / workflow do you use for Tailwind CSS?
back: Source files ──► Tailwind scanner (content globs) → Generated CSS (utilities + @layer base/components) → PostCSS pipeline ──► single bundled stylesheet → npm install tailwindcss @tailwindcss/vite

front: Given a broken Tailwind CSS setup, what is your first validation command?
back: Source files ──► Tailwind scanner (content globs)

front: Symptom: Classes have no effect — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Class not in scanned content paths · Fix: Add glob for new folder; rebuild

front: Symptom: Huge CSS in prod — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: CDN/play CDN Tailwind or missing purge · Fix: Use build pipeline; never @tailwindcss/browser in prod

front: Symptom: "Unknown at rule @tailwind" in editor — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: IDE doesn't know Tailwind · Fix: Install Tailwind CSS IntelliSense; set css.customData

front: Symptom: @apply fails on custom class — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Order / layer issue · Fix: Define in @layer components; import order matters

front: Symptom: Dark mode not working — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Wrong strategy (media vs class) · Fix: Set darkMode: 'class' + dark: variants on <html>

front: Symptom: Styles differ dev vs prod — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: JIT missed dynamic class string · Fix: Use full class names: text-${color}-500 won't scan — safelist

front: Symptom: v4 migration broken — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Mixed v3 @tailwind + v4 @import · Fix: Pick one version's entry pattern; read upgrade guide

front: Symptom: Prefix classes ignored — what do you check and fix?
back: Check: Forgot prefix in JSX · Fix: With prefix(tw), use tw:flex not flex

front: Gotcha with Tailwind CSS: what silently fails?
back: Dynamic class names don't purge — bg-${statusColor}-500 won't generate CSS unless every variant is safelisted. Use maps: { ok: 'bg-green-500', err: 'bg-red-500' }.

front: When should you NOT use Tailwind CSS?
back: Email templates — poor client support for utility-class HTML; use inline styles. Heavy bespoke design system with zero utility markup — consider CSS modules or tokens-only approach. No build step allowed — Tailwind v4 still needs compilation; raw CDN is dev/prototype only.
